units.evidence_span: Either of these changes would increase the amount of RTP revenues that are credited to fuel. However, I would note that any increase in the amount of RTP revenues credited to the fuel account will necessarily reduce
units.reason: P-058 and P-115: both options increase the RTP revenue credited to fuel. P-144: FCR customers pay all fuel costs net of the credit, so a bigger credit lowers their fuel charges relative to today's method. P-061: the remainder of RTP revenue goes to base, and P-115 says any increase to fuel 'will necessarily reduce' the RTP revenue offsetting base revenue requirements, so the same dollars leave the base side. 'The rest of the bill' is a gloss consistent with P-061's two separate rates.
